programs.name: Strength Training
programs.subtitle: Forge Raw Power
programs.description: Our core strength program is designed to build a powerful foundation. Focusing on compound lifts like the squat, deadlift, and bench press, we guide you to systematically increase your strength, build lean muscle, and develop unshakable stability. This is where true power is made.
programs.detailedDescription: Our Warrior Fitness program is the engine of our gym. It's a high-intensity functional training system designed to build the strength, endurance, and agility of a modern-day warrior. We combine compound lifts, explosive plyometrics, and grueling conditioning circuits to create a physique that is as capable as it looks.

keyTechniques.description: Building a powerful foundation with squats, deadlifts, and presses.
Shredding fat and building endurance with high-intensity circuits.
Developing athletic power with plyometrics and olympic lifts.
Pushing your limits with the support of the tribe.

testimonial.quote: I've never been in better shape in my life. The Warrior Fitness program is tough, but the results are undeniable. I feel strong, confident, and ready for anything.
testimonial.author: - Sarah K., 2 Year Member

programs.name: Mixed Martial Arts
programs.subtitle: Unleash the Complete Fighter
programs.description: Our MMA program integrates the most effective techniques from various combat disciplines. Learn striking, grappling, and wrestling in a dynamic environment that builds physical prowess and strategic thinking. Step into the cage and become a versatile and formidable martial artist.
programs.detailedDescription: Mixed Martial Arts is the fastest growing sport in the world, and for good reason. It combines the most effective techniques from every martial art into a single, unified system. Our program teaches you to seamlessly blend striking, wrestling, and grappling, making you a well-rounded and formidable opponent in any situation.

keyTechniques.name: Wrestling Takedowns
keyTechniques.description: Taking the fight to the ground on your terms.

keyTechniques.name: Cage Control
keyTechniques.description: Using the environment to your advantage.

keyTechniques.name: Strategic Transitions
keyTechniques.description: Flowing between striking and grappling seamlessly.

keyTechniques.name: Explosive Ground & Pound
keyTechniques.description: Finishing the fight with powerful strikes on the ground.

testimonial.quote: MMA training here is the real deal. It's not just about fighting; it's about strategy, discipline, and pushing your own boundaries.
testimonial.author: - Mike T., Amateur Fighter

programs.name: Jiu-Jitsu
programs.subtitle: The Art of Dominance
programs.description: Master the art of ground-based combat with our Jiu-Jitsu program. Often called 'the gentle art,' it teaches you how to use leverage and technique to control and submit larger opponents. Develop discipline, problem-solving skills, and unparalleled grappling ability on the mats.
programs.tagline: The Art of Control and Submission
programs.detailedDescription: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu is a martial art and combat sport based on ground fighting and submission holds. It focuses on the skill of controlling a resisting opponent in ways that force them to submit. It's a chess match where the human body is the set of pieces, emphasizing technique and leverage over size and strength.

keyTechniques.name: Guard Retention
keyTechniques.description: Mastering the art of defending from your back.

keyTechniques.name: Submissions
keyTechniques.description: Learning chokes and joint locks to finish the fight.

keyTechniques.name: Positional Dominance
keyTechniques.description: Controlling the opponent from superior positions.

keyTechniques.name: Sweeps & Reversals
keyTechniques.description: Using leverage and technique to reverse a bad situation.

testimonial.quote: BJJ at Cowarrior taught me that technique and determination can overcome any obstacle. It's the most challenging and rewarding thing I've ever done.
testimonial.author: - Alex R., Blue Belt

programs.name: Muay Thai
programs.subtitle: Unleash the Eight Limbs
programs.description: Master the art of eight limbs with our Muay Thai program. Learn powerful strikes using fists, elbows, knees, and shins, combined with effective clinching techniques. Develop explosive power, unwavering discipline, and a warrior's spirit.
programs.detailedDescription: Known for its tremendous power, efficiency, and raw simplicity, Muay Thai is a combat sport of Thailand that uses stand-up striking along with various clinching techniques. This physical and mental discipline is known as 'the art of eight limbs' because it is characterized by the combined use of fists, elbows, knees, and shins.

keyTechniques.name: Devastating Kicks
keyTechniques.description: Mastering the powerful roundhouse and teep kicks.

keyTechniques.name: Clinch Work
keyTechniques.description: Controlling the opponent in close quarters with knees and elbows.

keyTechniques.name: Defensive Shell
keyTechniques.description: Building a strong guard to block and counter strikes.

keyTechniques.name: Elite Conditioning
keyTechniques.description: Forging the endurance to fight round after round.

testimonial.quote: The energy in the Muay Thai class is insane. The coaches push you to your limit, and you leave feeling like a true fighter every single time.
testimonial.author: - Jessica P., 1 Year Member

coaches.name: Marcus 'The Titan' Thorne
coaches.title: Head Coach & Founder
coaches.bio: Marcus isn't just the founder of Cowarrior; he is its very foundation. A titan of the strength world, he has dedicated his life to the pursuit of raw power. His journey began in the gritty, no-nonsense powerlifting gyms of his youth, where he learned that true strength is forged in the crucible of struggle. With a coaching style that is both demanding and deeply supportive, Marcus pushes his athletes to shatter their preconceived limits and build a foundation of unshakeable physical and mental fortitude.
coaches.philosophy: We don't lift weights; we build pillars. Every squat, every deadlift, every press is a brick in the temple of your own strength. My goal is to give you the tools to build a monument.

coaches.name: Elena 'Viper' Ramirez
coaches.title: Head of CrossFit & Conditioning
coaches.bio: Elena is the engine of Cowarrior Gym. A whirlwind of energy and intensity, she is a former CrossFit Games athlete who lives and breathes high-performance fitness. Her 'Viper' moniker comes from her lightning-fast workouts and her ability to strike at the heart of her athletes' weaknesses, turning them into strengths. Elena believes that conditioning is the cornerstone of any warrior's arsenal, and her classes are designed to push you to the absolute edge of your capacity.
coaches.philosophy: Your body is a machine. My job is to teach you how to redline it safely. We work hard, we sweat, we suffer, and we come back stronger every single day. There are no shortcuts on the path to elite fitness.

coaches.name: Sam 'The Ghost' Chen
coaches.title: Mobility & Martial Arts Coach
coaches.bio: Sam is the silent force at Cowarrior Gym. A master of movement and a veteran of the Muay Thai ring, he is known as 'The Ghost' for his fluid, almost effortless technique. Sam believes that true power comes from a foundation of mobility and control. His classes are a blend of ancient martial arts wisdom and modern biomechanics, designed to help you move with grace, prevent injury, and unlock your body's full potential.
coaches.philosophy: A warrior who cannot move is a warrior who cannot fight. We build from the ground up, creating a body that is resilient, adaptable, and ready for anything. The fight is not always against an opponent; sometimes, it is against our own limitations.

testimonials.author: Sarah M.
testimonials.text: Best gym I've ever joined! The coaches are amazing and the community is so supportive. I've learned so much in just 6 months.

testimonials.author: Jessica L.
testimonials.text: The facilities are world-class and the atmosphere keeps me motivated every single day. This is more than a gym—it's a family.

programsSection.title: Programs for all levels from beginners to pros.
programsSection.description: Our gym has had both a local and a national presence since its founding in 2011, however its roots go much deeper. Our Team has been training and competing across the world in multiple combat sports to bring you the best instruction available. We are athletes, hobbyists, competitors, students and professionals. We strive to learn and grow while pushing others around us to do the same. We are a family, and we are a team.

coreValuesSection.title: Are We Right For You
coreValuesSection.introParagraph: At Warrior, we recognize that every student walks through our doors with a unique set of goals, motivations, and reasons for training. Some come to compete, some to get in shape, some for self-defense, and others to find structure or community. We believe wholeheartedly that these goals don't need to be the same for us to support one another.

values.heading: REALISM
values.description: We train for real life. The foundation of our practice is self-defense and practical application—not gamesmanship.

values.heading: Growth Mindset
values.description: We believe that who you are today doesn't define who you can become.

values.heading: Respect
values.description: Even when it's not obvious, respect is always present.

values.heading: Safety
values.description: Training is only sustainable when we take care of each other.

values.heading: Diversity
values.description: We embrace different styles, backgrounds, and perspectives.

values.heading: Cohesion
values.description: We are individuals, but we train as one team.

coachesSectionIntro.title: Our Coaches
coachesSectionIntro.introParagraph: With years of experience both in coaching and competing, you will not find a more well-rounded and professional coaching team to help you achieve your goals.
